info.title: Zeima API
info.description: Sync, organizations and licensing for the Zeima desktop app. Errors are `application/problem+json` (RFC 9457) with a stable `code`.

get.summary: Readiness: the dependencies (Keycloak, the database) are reachable
Find the API and the sign-in issuer from the server URL

200.description: Where to sign in and where the API lives

issuer.description: OpenID Connect issuer; its /.well-known/openid-configuration lists the endpoints

clientId.description: Public OAuth client the desktop app signs in with

minClientVersion.description: Oldest desktop app version (major.minor.patch) this server works with

schema.description: Where to sign in and where the API lives

get.summary: The signed-in user and their organizations

parameters.name: x-org-id
parameters.description: Active organization; must be one of the user's orgs.

get.summary: The workspaces the caller can use
get.description: A second device finds the personal workspace here and syncs into it instead of creating another.

post.description: The first sync of a local workspace uploads it as the caller's personal workspace with this id.
Each change is merged field by field (last write wins by HLC). The response has one result per change, in order. Rejected changes are not applied; the reason says why.

get.description: Returns the merged state of rows changed after `cursor`, oldest first, across all workspaces the caller can see. Merge each field into the local row with the same rule as push. Pass the returned `cursor` next time; `more` says to ask again.

get.summary: The caller's plan, features and signed entitlement token

expiresAt.description: End of the paid period, unix seconds

token.description: Ed25519-signed token for offline checks; null on the Free plan

put.description: The token must be signed by a trusted issuer (`ENTITLEMENT_PUBLIC_KEYS`). It replaces the license for the same user or organization.
